lines.prompt: Compute the maximum logic depth from input n0[0] to output n12.

golden.reference: No combinational path exists from n0[0] to n12; the point-to-point maximum logic depth is therefore 0 / undefined (state the no-path fact AND the resulting depth).
golden.notes: Both full-score teams state the no-path fact plus a depth: Team3 (17/17) 'no path ... so maximum logic depth is 0', Team7 (17/17) 'no path ... depth undefined' - so either 0 or undefined/N-A is accepted. Score arithmetic on the reliable teams: Team4 (16/17) matches the accepted answers on all 16 other lines, and its line-8 answer is the only divergence - a bare 'No combinational path exists' with no depth value - so this is most plausibly Team4's single lost point, i.e. a no-path statement alone without any depth statement may not earn credit. Team2's log is from a different run than its graded one, so no score inference is drawn from it; its logged answer ('depth of the current design is 0', design-wide scope, no no-path fact) would miss the point-to-point no-path fact regardless.
